title: Scaffold crate: Cargo.toml (name chtrie, edition 2021, no deps) and src/lib.rs stub; verify cargo build
Implement ChTrie::alloc (clamp n/m to >=1, ERANGE/overflow checks, ecap = (n-1)+(n-1)/3, global edge table, index pool) plus ChTrieError { Range, Capacity } and Drop
note: Size validation extracted into ChTrie::validate (clamping, i32 bounds, overflow guard) and runs BEFORE any allocation, so the guard boundary is testable without allocating.

title: Implement walk (bucket lookup by (from,sym), create with pool exhaustion -> Err(Capacity), free-list pop) and del (unlink edge, recycle child index); no unsafe
Port tests/test.c to tests/test.rs: add/del/query helpers with term/nchild state (N=65536, M=256) and all 14 query assertions unchanged
Add unit tests in lib.rs: ERANGE on oversized n/m, pool exhaustion -> Err(Capacity), index recycling (del then re-create reuses the index)
note: alloc_range_errors exercises the guard boundary via ChTrie::validate (no ~51 GB allocation); a small real allocation (n=1024) covers the success path.

title: Final gate: cargo build clean, cargo test all green, cargo clippy clean; update notes.md
